## Checklist

- [ ] This PR only touches files inside `submissions/<team-name>/`
- [ ] Team name is lowercase, `a-z`, `0-9` and `-` only, 3–30 characters
- [ ] `PROMPT.md` contains our single prompt, verbatim, in 600 characters or fewer
- [ ] `TEAM.md` lists at most 3 people, with their GitHub handles
- [ ] `screenshot.png` shows the screen in the "partially filled" state, like the reference
- [ ] `demo.gif` or `demo.mp4` (10 MB or less) is included
- [ ] `app/` contains the template we started from plus our changes
- [ ] We used **one** AI prompt, and we can show the chat history if we finish in the top 3
